# chowdsp_wdf

This project uses chowdsp_wdf (https://github.com/Chowdhury-DSP/chowdsp_wdf),
a header-only C++ library for wave digital filter circuit modeling.

chowdsp_wdf is licensed under the MIT License (see LICENSES/MIT.txt).

The library implements the Werner et al. 2015 WDF diode model using the Wright
Omega function approximation, providing physically accurate nonlinear circuit
simulation without Newton-Raphson iteration.
